validation_case.given: a Composer bin directory containing both an extensionless executable and a Windows .bat wrapper
validation_case.when: a Linux process runner selects the first existing candidate without checking host compatibility
validation_case.then: proc_open can fail with Exec format error, so the runner selects the host-appropriate executable before invoking it

content.title: Select the host's Composer wrapper before invoking a vendor binary
content.context: Composer installs both an extensionless wrapper and a Windows `.bat` file in vendor/bin. On Linux, ProcessRunner once chose `vendor/bin/phpstan.bat` first, so proc_open failed with `Exec format error` and the deterministic project PHPStan gate could not run.
content.guidance: Resolve a Composer-provided binary for the current platform before invoking it: on Windows prefer `<name>.bat`, elsewhere use only the extensionless wrapper. Keep that decision in one place (currently `ProcessRunner::vendorBinary()`), not in each caller.
content.why_it_works: A file that exists is not necessarily executable on this host; deciding by platform first means the first existing candidate is also a runnable one.
content.when_to_apply: When code launches a package binary from vendor/bin through proc_open or a similar API on more than one operating system.
content.when_not_to_apply: For commands run through a shell that already resolves the platform wrapper, or for third-party executables outside Composer's vendor/bin layout.
content.symptoms: A process runner that works on Windows fails on Linux (or the reverse) with an exec-format or not-executable error, although the file it picked exists.
content.root_cause: Candidate selection checked only that a file exists, not that it is executable on the current host.
